title: LoL
subtitle: Illustrative public comparison cohort for the Hawkar intelligence baseline

scientific_boundary.purpose: Provide memorable public reference points for cognitive-profile discussion, not declare equivalence of achievement, personality, talent or measured IQ.

cohort.name: Richard Feynman
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Widely reported school IQ result around 125; exact modern psychometric equivalence is not established.
cohort.comparison_role: Closest memorable numeric reference near the lower edge of the Hawkar inferred range.

cohort.name: William Shockley
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Biographical sources have reported childhood test results around 125-129; test equivalence to modern IQ instruments is limited.
cohort.comparison_role: Reported numeric results overlapping the Hawkar inferred range.

cohort.name: Geena Davis
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Known Mensa member; exact comparable IQ score is not treated as established here.
known_for: Founder of the Geena Davis Institute on Gender in Media
cohort.comparison_role: Example that high tested ability can express outside mathematics and engineering.

cohort.name: Martin Cooper
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Known Mensa member; exact comparable IQ score is not treated as established here.
known_for: Leadership of the Motorola team associated with the first handheld cellular phone

cohort.name: Isaac Asimov
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Historically associated with Mensa; exact modern comparable IQ score is not treated as established here.
cohort.comparison_role: Broad synthesis and cross-domain conceptualization reference.

cohort.name: Nolan Gould
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Publicly associated with Mensa; exact comparable IQ score is not treated as established here.
cohort.comparison_role: Another example that high test performance need not map to a STEM career.

cohort.name: Hawkar
cohort.public_intelligence_reference: Current GPT-5.6 Sol GitHub-derived non-psychometric estimate: 125-135, center approximately 130.
cohort.comparison_role: Subject of the longitudinal Habitat calibration program; not declared equivalent in achievement or measured IQ to any other cohort member.

interpretation.core_message: Similar broad ability ranges can express through very different cognitive profiles and life outcomes.
interpretation.habitat_use: Use LoL as a human-readable reference layer alongside quantitative longitudinal calibration, never as a scoring authority.
